name: Teen Summer Musical
what_you_do: A summer theater program where youth rehearse and perform a full musical (Peter Pan in 2026). The program is aimed at youth of color. Rehearsals ran June 29 to Aug 27 in 2026, with shows Aug 28 to 30.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 9 to 18, aimed at youth of color. Auditions are held each spring.
pay_detail: Cost $350 for ages 13 to 15 ($400 for ages 9 to 12) but participants get a stipend: $599 for ages 13 to 15. Ages 16 to 18 are paid minimum wage ($21.30 per hour in 2026) every 2 weeks.
duration: 2026: rehearsals June 29 to Aug 27, shows Aug 28 to 30
deadline_text: 2026 auditions were April 17 and 18. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Audition in the spring. Contact the director listed on the page for sign-up details.
notes: Breakfast and lunch are provided. The page says costs are paid by ages 9 to 15 and stipends are paid at the end. Work permit rule not stated.
